verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack documents a setting to disable Langfuse's own product telemetry or usage tracking. Self-hosting (MIT-licensed, Docker/Kubernetes) keeps trace data on your own infrastructure, but that is a related deployment option, not a telemetry opt-out. The many 'tracking' references describe Langfuse tracing the user's LLM apps, which is a different feature.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
